findings: Silent status downgrade without activity — checkPermissionStatus() returns "denied" when activityBinding is null and the true state is permanentlyDenied. The Dart layer receives no signal that the value is a safe fallback, so requestPermission may be attempted when the app should direct the user to Settings instead. Address in P3-06.

Pending result overwrite in openFolderPicker — a second openFolderPicker call before the Activity result arrives overwrites pendingFolderPickerResult; the first caller never receives a reply. Add a guard that errors the first caller or rejects the new call if one is already pending.

Null-root in collectVideoFiles masks folder-not-found — when DocumentFile.fromTreeUri returns null, the traversal silently returns an empty list with no error. The caller cannot distinguish an empty folder from a folder that could not be opened. Return LIST_FAILED for the null-root case.
